annotations.title: Search German and Austrian property listings (ImmoScout24)

description: Apartments and houses for rent or sale in Germany or Austria: price, rent, area, rooms, address with coordinates, energy class, features, agent, photos and dates. Not Switzerland. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/immobilienscout24-scraper on your Apify account (about $0.001 per listing; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

changes_only.description: Only listings that are new, changed (old and new price, rent, size, rooms) or removed since the last call with the same search. For price tracking on a schedule.

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

locations.description: Cities, districts or regions in plain words, e.g. ["Berlin","München Schwabing"]; in Austria a city or federal state, e.g. ["Wien","Tirol"].

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 50, max 500). Cost scales with this.

max_price.description: Maximum price in EUR (monthly rent or purchase price).

min_price.description: Minimum price in EUR (monthly rent or purchase price).

name: search_german_property_listings

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Search German and Austrian property listings (ImmoScout24)
